title: {Syn} Collatz Is the Tiny Monster of Iteration
content:
The Collatz rule is simple: if n is even, divide by 2; if n is odd, replace it with 3n + 1. The conjecture says every positive starting value eventually reaches 1.

No counterexample is known, and no proof is known. It is a perfect warning that small programs can generate deep mathematical trouble.

Why it matters: math facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
